description: Hob-B-Bookcraft brand photo album and envelope for Nuage Mounting Corners. The album has a grey and blue cover with gold and red accents, and text on the spine: "Standard Title Here" and "Your Own Personalized Title Here." Several of the first and last pages contain adhered photo mounting corners where the album previously held O'Keeffe's photographs. Some pages are perforated and have come loose, including a half page that describes the "exclusive features of the Hob-B-Book." The envelope still contains several mounting corners.
title: Hob-B-Bookcraft, album
